messages:
Ivy Chen: Drafted a compact quickstart PR that focuses on a one-file hello-world and minimal auth guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4920
Rafael Gomez: Nice. Can we standardize on REDWOOD_TOKEN everywhere and remove references to old API_KEY? Also prefer token file for Docker examples.
Nina Brooks: Agreed. Add a tiny curl smoke test but label it: 'for quick verification only'. Replace long examples with the SDK v5 snippet using async/await.
Ivy Chen: Updated examples. Curl now: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'` with a short note. Docker example uses a mounted token file at /etc/secrets/redwood.token.
Rafael Gomez: Small nit: the JS snippet should destructure result: `const { output } = await client.responses.create(...)` and show output[0].content or similar. Also add a one-line migration note for v4 -> v5 naming changes.
Nina Brooks: Add a callout: 'Streaming is restricted on trial accounts; paid plans and dedicated deployments support streaming.' Save a link to billing/limits.
ci-bot: Linkcheck: found one stale link to examples/hello-old.md. Docs build: two warnings about image alt text.
Ivy Chen: Fixed the stale link and added alt text. Reworded the sidebar security tip to recommend KMS for production.
Rafael Gomez: Approving once CI passes.
Nina Brooks: Approving 44d.
ci-bot: All checks passed. Merged by Ivy Chen.
Ivy Chen: Created follow-up issue to add an interactive CodeSandbox demo that uses a fake token and client-side mock for learning: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2142
Rafael Gomez: Great work, this should reduce first-run friction. :tada:
